exposure: infants with typical vs. atypical bacterial or fungal microbiome maturation patterns
prenatal exposure to artificially sweetened beverages
cohort: 100 infants from the CHILD Cohort Study
finding: Divergent patterns of gut bacterial or fungal microbiome maturation were identified in over 40% of infants, characterized by differences in community composition, inter-kingdom dynamics, and microbe-derived metabolites in urine.
mod_finding: C-section delivery was associated with atypical bacterial, but not fungal, microbiome maturation patterns.
